tei:div.tei:p: )rang gi spyi bor chos sku kun tu bzang po la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyis tshig don dang mthun pas bskor bar bsgom la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs/ kun tu bzang po bya bral chos kyi sku// rdo rje 'chang chen gsal rigs yab kyi dbyings// bde chen mkha' spyod ye shes sprul pa'i yum// rigs kun bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sogs// rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla mar mchod pa 'bul// dga' rab rdo rje bde chen lha yi lha// pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul sku dri ma med// ye shes mtsho rgyal gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma// chos blo mgon po 'gro ba'i don du bsngags// rig 'dzin rig brgyud bla mar mchod pa 'bul// mchog ldan rdo rje grub chen sprul pa'i sku// jo mo sgrol ma shes rab snyems ma'i tshul// rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin chen po'i dpal// sprul dang yang sprul rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// snyan brgyud gter brgyud bcas la mchod pa 'bul// stag sham rdo rje theg dgu'i bcud gter bdag /chos rje gling pa zab gter gnyis 'dzin spel// rig 'dzin dbang rgyal snang srid chos skur rtogs// dus bab las sad gter chos brgyud par mchod// dmar nag cod pan 'chang ba'i karma pa// mthu stobs gling pa chos kyi 'byung gnas zhabs// ngag dbang grags pa khyab brdal lhun grub rje// zab gter lung zin chos bdag thams cad mchod// nam mkha' rdo rje pad+ma rnam par rgyal// bstan 'dzin dbang phyug rta mchog chos kyi grags// pad+ma dgyes rdor chos dpal phrin las mtshan// bde byed rol pa me tog nges don rje// tshe dbang mchog grub byang chub gzhan phan sogs// don brgyud nor bu'i phreng ba thams cad mchod// yi dam dgongs 'dus pad+ma yongs grol gyi// rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams chos srung mchod// de ltar mchod pas tshogs rdzogs sgrib bzhi byang*// sdug bsngal mtsho grol mthar thug sangs rgyas shog

/ces pa'ang stag sham gter chen gsungs la brgyud pa'i khyad par pad+ma bde byed rol pas kha sab sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ sangs rgyas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos mchod pa 'bul// gdod ma'i gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa dang*// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par byin gyis rlobs/// /
